sourceFacts: Current public code supports distinct grayscale palette, fine-pointer half-fill,1.8s split curtain with.12s delay, and clipped16px/26pointtrail. The actual Graphic branch has fifteen static tiles, not autoplay sliders.
adaptations: Graphic branch is presented within the independent Framer draft instead of separate source routing.
Phone gate geometry is fitted to its assigned native bounds.

The native SVG now uses the source quadratic midpoint geometry. A30Hz publication cap, time-normalized0.32 easing and finite rest replace the source continuous Canvas loop; curtain easing now follows the source fourth-power curve with a bounded CSS linear() approximation.
A small DOM square replaces the source full-window cursor canvas; the existing tile SVG replaces its blue trail canvas.
Source frame-based0.32 easing is time-normalized; source continuous idle scheduling is replaced with finite rest.
Reduced motion retains the standard native pointer throughout; no custom cursor or cursor:none style is installed.
The cursor is scoped to its own gallery; re-entering from a project tile seeds the current pointer rather than carrying a separate global cursor history.
